gaps.concept: Simple functional cysts are thin-walled, unilocular, and anechoic on ultrasound; most regress spontaneously.
gaps.why_tested: A reproductive-age patient has an incidental simple adnexal cyst without malignant features.

gaps.concept: Rupture of a hemorrhagic corpus luteum can cause sudden pelvic pain and hemoperitoneum.
gaps.why_tested: Acute unilateral pain follows ovulation, with free pelvic fluid and a negative pregnancy test.

gaps.concept: An ovarian endometrioma contains old blood and produces homogeneous ground-glass echoes on ultrasound.
gaps.why_tested: An adnexal cyst in a patient with dysmenorrhea has uniform low-level internal echoes.

gaps.concept: Ovarian torsion initially obstructs venous drainage, causing edema and potentially hemorrhagic infarction.
gaps.why_tested: A twisted adnexa appears enlarged and edematous before arterial supply is lost.

gaps.concept: Preserved Doppler arterial flow does not exclude torsion; an enlarged ovary with peripheral follicles or a whirlpool sign supports it.
gaps.why_tested: Sudden unilateral pain persists despite detectable ovarian arterial flow.

gaps.concept: Borderline epithelial ovarian tumors show epithelial proliferation and atypia without destructive stromal invasion.
gaps.why_tested: Histology asks whether a papillary ovarian tumor is borderline or invasive carcinoma.

gaps.concept: Low-grade serous carcinoma often arises from a serous borderline tumor and commonly has KRAS or BRAF pathway mutations.
gaps.why_tested: A younger patient’s serous tumor lacks the TP53 pattern of high-grade carcinoma.

gaps.concept: Serous ovarian tumors are often bilateral; primary mucinous tumors are usually large and unilateral.
gaps.why_tested: Tumor size and laterality help distinguish epithelial subtypes and raise suspicion for metastasis.

gaps.concept: Ovarian carcinoma commonly spreads by peritoneal seeding, producing ascites and omental implants.
gaps.why_tested: An adnexal mass accompanies abdominal distention and omental caking.

gaps.concept: Ovarian carcinoma may present with persistent bloating, early satiety, and increased abdominal girth.
gaps.why_tested: A postmenopausal patient has vague gastrointestinal symptoms before an adnexal malignancy is found.

gaps.concept: CA-125 and transvaginal ultrasound are ineffective screening tests for average-risk asymptomatic patients.
gaps.why_tested: A question asks whether routine testing can reliably detect early ovarian cancer.

gaps.concept: BRCA1/2 loss impairs homologous recombination repair; PARP inhibitors exploit this defect through synthetic lethality.
gaps.why_tested: A BRCA-associated ovarian cancer question asks for the mechanism of targeted therapy.

gaps.concept: Lynch-associated ovarian cancers arise from defective DNA mismatch repair, including MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, or PMS2.
gaps.why_tested: Ovarian cancer occurs alongside a family history of colorectal and endometrial cancers.

gaps.concept: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma can show glycogen-rich clear cytoplasm and hobnail cells.
gaps.why_tested: Histology from an endometriosis-associated ovarian mass requires subtype identification.

gaps.concept: Ovarian endometrioid carcinoma can coexist with endometrial adenocarcinoma.
gaps.why_tested: Similar gland-forming tumors are found in the ovary and endometrium.

gaps.concept: Mature cystic teratomas contain differentiated tissues from multiple germ layers; struma ovarii may cause hyperthyroidism.
gaps.why_tested: An ovarian mass contains thyroid tissue in a patient with thyrotoxicosis.

gaps.concept: Dysgerminoma contains fibrous septa with lymphocytic infiltrates between sheets of tumor cells.
gaps.why_tested: An ovarian germ cell tumor is identified from its characteristic microscopic architecture.

gaps.concept: Y-chromosome material in a dysgenetic gonad predisposes to gonadoblastoma, which may progress to dysgerminoma.
gaps.why_tested: A phenotypic female with gonadal dysgenesis develops a germ cell tumor.

gaps.concept: Adult granulosa cell tumors commonly harbor FOXL2 mutations; excess inhibin suppresses FSH.
gaps.why_tested: An estrogen-secreting ovarian mass has elevated inhibin and reduced FSH.

gaps.concept: Sertoli-Leydig tumors may harbor DICER1 mutations; ovarian androgen production causes virilization with relatively normal DHEA-S.
gaps.why_tested: Rapid virilization and an ovarian mass must be distinguished from an adrenal androgen source.

gaps.concept: Thecomas can secrete estrogen and cause postmenopausal bleeding or endometrial hyperplasia.
gaps.why_tested: A solid ovarian mass accompanies unexplained estrogen exposure after menopause.

gaps.concept: Hydrosalpinx is a fluid-filled, dilated fallopian tube, often resulting from prior salpingitis and associated with infertility.
gaps.why_tested: Ultrasound shows a tubular cystic adnexal structure after pelvic inflammatory disease.
